title: pvTransposeTable
body:
## pvTransposeTable

Builds a sub-table from selected columns of a table and, by default, transposes it so that each selected column becomes a row; a first column holding the original column names is added by default. With Onlyextractselectedcolumns it skips the transposition and simply returns the selected columns. Use it to reshape statistics or probe tables for plotting or export.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Only the listed columns are kept; with no selection the output is empty.
- Transposing mixes columns of different types into rows; check the output column types before numeric processing.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `TransposeTable`. Identity: `filters/TransposeTable`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the filter. Accepted data: tables (rows and columns) (vtkTable). The input needs at least one row (table) array with 1 component. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkTable"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Addacolumnwithoriginalcolumnsname` | This flag indicates if a column must be inserted at index 0 with the names (ids) of the input columns. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Onlyextractselectedcolumns` | This flag indicates if the sub-table must be effectively transposed or not. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Usethecolumnwithoriginalcolumnsname` | This flag indicates if the output column must be named using the names listed in the index 0 column. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `VariablesofInterest` | Choose arrays whose entries will be used to form observations for statistical analysis. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

```json
  }
```
```json
}
```
